domain.description: Medias whose domain contains this text, 1 to 255 characters.

websiteType.description: A comma-separated list of website types: `blog`, `press`.

language.description: A comma-separated list of language codes, as in GET /vocabulary.

country.description: A comma-separated list of country codes, as in GET /vocabulary.

topics.description: A comma-separated list of topic ids, as in GET /vocabulary: medias on any of them.

trafficTrendUpward.description: Medias whose traffic is growing. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

homepageListing.description: Medias that offer listing the post on their homepage. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

hasLinkAddition.description: Medias that offer adding a link to an existing article. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

maxLinkAdditionPrice.description: Maximum link addition price, in cents.

favourite.description: `true`: only your favourites for the project; `false`: leave them out.

requested.description: `true`: only the medias you requested for the project; `false`: leave them out.

bought.description: `true`: only medias you bought for the project; `false`: leave them out.

new.description: Medias Growwer matched with the project recently. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

language.description: A language code, as in GET /vocabulary.

country.description: A country code, as in GET /vocabulary, or null for none.

topics.description: Topic ids, as in GET /vocabulary.

metrics.description: The latest measurements; each is null until it is first measured.

publicationRate.description: The share of the media's orders that were published, in percent, or null without orders.

averageDaysToPublication.description: The average days from order to publication, or null without published orders.

linkAdditionOffer.description: Adding a link to an existing article, or null when the media does not offer it.
